Wonderful dinner with a very good services
Jan 2026 • Couples
First off, every bite was fire—their lobster is so fresh and juicy, cooked to absolute perfection. But let’s talk about the SHRIMP—HOLY MOLY it’s the best shrimp I’ve ever tasted in my life. Tender, flavorful, 10/10 would fight someone for a second serving.
 
And don’t even get me started on the FREE FRO WINE—what a game-changer! It paired so well with the seafood and was such a nice surprise that made the night feel extra special.
 
Shoutout to Chris and Dat who took care of us—these two know their stuff! Their knowledge of the food and wine is tremendous—they explained every dish in detail and gave spot-on recommendations. Super friendly and made us feel right at home.
 
If you’re looking for a top-tier seafood spot, RUN to this restaurant—you won’t regret it! 🙌

每一口都香到上头——他家的龙虾新鲜弹牙，火候拿捏得恰到好处，简直绝了！但重点必须夸夸虾——我的天，这绝对是我这辈子吃过最好吃的虾！肉质嫩到离谱，调味更是绝，好吃到我愿意为了第二份“大打出手”，直接封神！
 
更别提那免费的FRO葡萄酒了，简直是神来之笔！和海鲜搭配得天衣无缝，这个惊喜直接把当晚的快乐值拉满！
 
必须点名表扬招待我们的克里斯和达特，这两位真的太懂行了！他们对菜品和酒水的了解超级深入，不仅把每道菜的门道讲得明明白白，推荐的搭配也精准到不行。人还特别热情，全程都让我们感觉超自在！
 
想找顶级海鲜馆子的宝子，听我的，冲就完事了——绝对不亏！🙌
